items.html:
Mohammad Sheikh is the baby of the 1999 World Cup Squad, just
18 at the atart of the tournament and still at school.  He already has 15 One-
Day Internationals under his belt, and has visited England to play for South
Minns (Hertfordshire) CC.

stories.summary: Kenya's preparations for the Intercontinental Cup tie against Namibia at Windhoek  are in chaos following the ICC's decision not to allow the match to be postponed

stories.title: Former Kenyan player debuts for South Australia
